# ImgBB

ImgBB is a free image hosting and sharing service that allows users to upload and share images easily.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/imgbb/.

## Actions

- **Upload Image to ImgBB**: Upload an image to ImgBB.
- **Get ImgBB API Key**: Retrieve and validate the ImgBB API key.
